dossier.purpose: Rust server + CLI giving coding agents shared long-term memory. Lifecycle hooks (Claude Code, Codex, 20+ others) send sanitized observations to a local/LAN server. At session end it writes markdown pages into a git-versioned wiki (source of truth), indexes them in SQLite (FTS5, entities, links, optional local vectors) and opens a single-use handoff for the next agent. Agents search/write/delete via 23 MCP tools (stdio or streamable HTTP). Default path uses no LLM; LLM consolidation, auto-improve and an idle 'dream' pass are opt-in. `ai-memory run` adds cross-harness native-session resume. (README.md:8-11,83-98; docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:7-21)

claims.claim: Quit Claude Code mid-task, start Codex in the same directory, continue without re-explaining.
Twenty-plus harnesses feed one shared memory; handoffs are 'typed, owned, claimed exactly once'.
Memory lives in a server you run (laptop/homelab); 'one server per data directory, never two'.
Memory is plain markdown in a git-backed wiki; 'The database is a derived index that can always be rebuilt from the files.'
Hooks capture prompts/tool calls/session boundaries, 'sanitized at a typed privacy boundary before anything is stored'; default path uses zero LLM calls.
Memory decays on a schedule; 'Nothing is hard-deleted: the original stays in git and the version chain (restore-page brings it back)'; compaction/dedup/per-tier curves off by default.
Opt-in LLM 'dream' pass never deletes a source and is off by default.
One self-contained binary; purge commands say exactly what 'deleted' means; measured write ceiling (~700/s); audit log of every mutation.
Linux, macOS, WSL2 Supported; native Windows Experimental; Claude Code and Codex Supported; rows are first-party integrations 'kept honest by CI'.
`ai-memory run` auto-installs a harness's hooks+MCP on first launch (opt out --no-autowire) and adds cross-harness session continuity.
`ai-memory uninstall --apply` removes everything ai-memory installed and only that; installers are idempotent and write timestamped backups.
Default is loopback-only with no auth; per-repo [capture] rules can exclude paths or invert to allowlist mode.
LLM providers are optional; everything works with zero LLM calls.
MIT license; code 'built collaboratively with Claude Code (Anthropic Claude Opus 4.7)'.

integrations.cli: Single `ai-memory` binary, ~60 subcommands (crates/ai-memory-cli/src/lib.rs:86-183): serve, hook, install-hooks/install-mcp/uninstall, run/continue, status/doctor/search/read-page, checkpoints/restore-page, purge-session/purge-project, backup/restore/reindex, forget-sweep, handoffs, finalize-session, user/api-key/project.
integrations.mcp: MCP server with 23 tools (crates/ai-memory-mcp/src/server.rs; docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:446-479) over stdio or streamable HTTP, default http://127.0.0.1:49374/mcp (crates/ai-memory-cli/src/cli.rs:2839-2853; config.rs:43). `ai-memory mcp-bridge` is a stdio bridge that forwards Claude's session id (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:518-525).
integrations.sdk_or_api: HTTP API: /hook, /hook/batch, /handoff (crates/ai-memory-hooks/src/router.rs:609-611), /admin/* incl. /admin/audit-log, /admin/purge-session, /admin/restore-page (crates/ai-memory-mcp/src/admin.rs:635-743), /auth/*, read-only /api/v1 + /web with --enable-web (docs/frontend-api.md). No published language SDK found; crates are not on crates.io (docs/install.md:1648-1651). Companions: companions/ai-memory-relay, ai-memory-importer.
integrations.claude_code_or_codex: Both documented. Claude Code: install-mcp writes ~/.claude.json (install_mcp.rs:388-405); install-hooks edits ~/.claude/settings.json, 9 events (install_hooks.rs:44-62; render_shared.rs:36-49); optional --session-aware MCP bridge. Codex: install-mcp writes [mcp_servers.ai-memory] in ~/.codex/config.toml with default_tools_approval_mode='approve' (install_mcp.rs:407-422,1027-1087); install-hooks writes ~/.codex/hooks.json, 7 events, Codex must trust the hooks (install_hooks.rs:2071-2183; render_shared.rs:907-915); SessionEnd needs Codex CLI >=0.145.0 else `finalize-session` (docs/install.md:844-855). Both: `ai-memory run claude|codex` (README.md:355-359); known Codex daemon issue #987 (docs/managed-workstreams.md:503-522).

readme.telemetry_and_network: No telemetry/analytics/crash reporting (DATA_HANDLING.md:10-14); no such crates in Cargo.lock; 'telemetry' symbols in crates/ are local auto-improve reports (crates/ai-memory-consolidate/src/auto_improve_telemetry.rs). No account or hosted service required; core is a loopback server (127.0.0.1:49374) on a local data dir; LAN binds are refused without a token (SECURITY.md:36-45). Network egress that exists: (1) DEFAULT first-start download of ~87 MB all-MiniLM-L6-v2 weights from huggingface.co, sha256-pinned, background, skipped with embedding_provider='none' or pre-placed files (crates/ai-memory-llm/src/local.rs:49-113; serve.rs:2436-2477; config.rs:2162-2171; docs/local-embeddings.md:65-83); DATA_HANDLING.md:31-32 says local embeddings need no network call. (2) Opt-in cloud LLM/embedding providers, capture_assistant, AI_MEMORY_RERANKER=llm send page text/assistant excerpts/queries (DATA_HANDLING.md:34-72). The `codex` provider reuses Codex's auth.json and may call `codex app-server --stdio` (docs/install.md:1886-1907); `anthropic-oauth` reuses a Claude subscription token that docs call unofficial and against Anthropic's usage policies (docs/install.md:1786-1798). (3) `ai-memory upgrade`, explicit only, calls GitHub Releases (upgrade.rs:341; lib.rs:175). (4) Docker wrapper checks Docker Hub digests at most daily on a TTY, opt-out AI_MEMORY_NO_VERSION_CHECK=1 (bin/ai-memory:134-184). (5) Admission webhooks (crates/ai-memory-wiki/Cargo.toml:33-34) and OIDC device auth (docs/install.md:399-415) are operator-configured.

code.architecture: Cargo workspace (Cargo.toml:1-43): ai-memory-core (types, Sanitized<T> boundary: src/sanitize.rs:327-362); ai-memory-store (SQLite via bundled rusqlite; single writer actor src/writer.rs, readers src/reader.rs, SQL src/ops.rs, migrations V01-V70, decay src/decay.rs); ai-memory-wiki (atomic md writes, watcher, git2 versioning src/git.rs, restore_page_from_checkpoint src/wiki.rs:732); ai-memory-hooks (payloads, /hook router src/router.rs, rule-based session pages src/synth.rs, capture_policy.rs); ai-memory-mcp (rmcp server, admin, auth); ai-memory-llm (providers/embedders, local candle MiniLM src/local.rs); ai-memory-consolidate (consolidator, auto_improve, sweep, lint, dream); ai-memory-web (read-only axum+askama browser, /api/v1); ai-memory-workstream (read-only adapters over native Claude/Codex/etc. transcripts + launch plans); ai-memory-cli (binary). One server owns a data dir: wiki/ (git, source of truth), db/memory.sqlite (index, but sole copy of sessions/observations/handoffs/audit/users), raw/, models/, logs/; single-instance lock. Agents reach it via hook commands (local spool, batch POST) and MCP.
code.packaging_and_release: Tag-triggered .github/workflows/release.yml: checks tag == Cargo.toml version (31-60); `cargo build --locked --release` tarballs linux-{x86_64,aarch64}, macos-{aarch64,x86_64}, windows zip, RPMs, each with .sha256 made in the same workflow; also wrapper scripts, ai-memory-install-hooks and hooks tarball with SHA-256; GitHub Release body lists checksums (489-564). Docker Hub multi-arch image (provenance:false, lines 354,414) and AUR publish are gated on repo secrets (288-313,315-478,566-670). No signatures, cosign, SLSA/GitHub attestations or SBOM anywhere in .github (grep); docs concede this (docs/install.md:1636-1638). Actions pinned to commit SHAs; token read-only except release job (release.yml:27-28,493-494). Release does not run tests or depend on CI (release.yml:15-17). bin/release makes an annotated, unsigned-in-script tag (bin/release:196). Dockerfile: debian bookworm-slim, non-root uid 1000 (docker/Dockerfile:34-67). flake.nix is CI-built; no user docs found.

About 120 Rust integration-test files under crates/*/tests/suite plus ~4,277 #[test]/#[tokio::test]/#[rstest] attributes across 274 files in crates/ (grep); evals/tests/smoke.rs; tests/hooks/test_lib.sh; tests/wrapper_upgrade.sh; tests/e2e/external_relay_smoke.py; tests/e2e/handoff_smoke.sh (needs GEMINI_API_KEY, not referenced by any workflow); 4 Swift test files. risks: Handoff delivery is first-session-wins: any next SessionStart in the same project (any harness, scripted or interactive) claims the single-use baton; to_agent is stored but unused, there is no per-execution opt-out, and the 'offer, don't claim' fix is accepted design 'not implemented' (docs/design-handoff-offer-not-claim.md:3-30,61-74; absent from crates/). Manual handoffs are project-wide and outrank automatic ones (docs/usage.md:19-27).

Codex-specific: install-mcp sets default_tools_approval_mode='approve' for the whole ai-memory server, so memory_delete_page/memory_forget_sweep/memory_write_page run without a Codex prompt (install_mcp.rs:1066-1078); hooks need manual Codex trust (install_hooks.rs:2171-2181); Codex MCP is not session-aware, so unscoped calls use a last-active-project pointer and static clients must pass workspace+project (docs/usage.md:52-55,212-220; docs/auto-scope.md:35-41); `ai-memory run codex` can lose continuity via Codex's shared daemon (#987, workaround --no-daemon) (docs/managed-workstreams.md:503-522); hook formats are verified against specific Codex versions (docs/install.md:827-828).

Default retention: maintenance is on; rule-based session pages are Tier::Episodic and are evicted when retention <0.20 (~80 days unused), tombstone ancestry is hard-deleted after 180 days, TTL pages are hard-deleted (config.rs:1285-1294; synth.rs:65; decay.rs:99-100; config.default.toml:74-76). Without an LLM provider no decisions/concepts/gotchas pages are made automatically, only session pages and handoffs; durable pages need memory_write_page (default tier semantic, server.rs:3810) or a provider (docs/install.md:1719; serve.rs:2560). With a provider, the hourly auto-improve scheduler auto-approves LLM-written pages by default (config.default.toml:180-201; docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:98-111).

Deletion/recovery limits: purge-* are logical deletes (bytes stay in SQLite free pages until --compact; text remains in wiki git history and older backups; 'not forensic erasure') (docs/lifecycle-ops.md:49-72); no encryption at rest (SECURITY.md:146); restore-page recovers only page markdown, while sessions/observations/handoffs/users/audit are DB-only and need backup/restore with the server stopped (docs/lifecycle-ops.md:24,921-925; reindex.rs:16-18).

Capture scope/privacy: unmarked repos are captured by default (prompts up to 16 KiB, tool excerpts up to 2 KB) for Claude Code and Codex; allowlist mode and --no-capture-prompts (Claude only) are opt-in (docs/install.md:488-551). Native hook events wait in <data_dir>/hook-spool/ before server-side scrubbing (hook_spool.rs:1-21). The default loopback server needs no token and the Docker/systemd defaults pass --enable-web (docs/install.md:2459-2474; docker/Dockerfile:67; packaging/systemd/ai-memory-user.service:8; docs/usage.md:423-424). First SessionStart in an empty project spawns a detached import of existing local transcripts (config.rs:392-400; hook.rs:836-851).

Release/supply chain: integrity is SHA-256 sidecars from the same workflow (no signatures, attestations, SLSA, SBOM; docs/install.md:1636-1638,2614-2619); release is not gated on CI (release.yml:15-17); no macOS signing/notarization (companions/ai-memory-macos/README.md:38); Docker provenance disabled (release.yml:354,414); Dependabot covers only GitHub Actions (.github/dependabot.yml); cargo audit ignores RUSTSEC-2025-0141 and RUSTSEC-2024-0320 without in-repo rationale (ci.yml:352-355); the Docker CLI wrapper bind-mounts $HOME read-write (bin/ai-memory:888).

Maintenance/licensing: ~125 changelog releases from 0.1.0 (2026-05-23) to 2.5.2 (2026-10-01), with 2.5.1 and 2.5.2 both dated 2026-10-01 (CHANGELOG.md:10,75,7592); Cargo.toml lists one author (Cargo.toml:43); README says code is built with Claude Code (README.md:501-503); only the latest release gets security fixes (SECURITY.md:157-160); forward-only migrations (V70), older binaries refuse newer data (docs/install.md:2624-2630); 2.5.2 fixed a per-project authz info leak GHSA-gf78-hf8g-vffm (CHANGELOG.md:59-66); serde_yaml is deprecated (Cargo.lock:3641-3642). MIT, but evals/Cargo.toml:6 declares 'MIT OR Apache-2.0'; deny.toml allows MPL-2.0 (deny.toml:37).

Operations/platform/scope: needs a long-running local server; if down, hook events are dropped after 8 failed drains, 7 days or 10,000 files (hook_spool.rs:33-44); each hook call adds ~145 ms (docs/install.md:460-476); one server per data dir (cli.rs:2866-2872); main.rs notes queued writes are dropped at shutdown (main.rs:20-33); first start fetches a model from huggingface.co (local.rs:49-113). Native Windows is Experimental; macOS/Windows CI legs are conditional; WSL2 has no CI. Also ships an agent launcher (`run`, --yolo/ai-jail, 20+ adapters) beyond memory (docs/managed-workstreams.md:483-493).
